Title: IInferenceNode — Inference Abstraction
Content: Single IInferenceNode interface decouples all routing, agent, and MCP logic from providers. Key members: NodeId (string), Provider (NodeProviderType enum: Ollama, CopilotSdk, Worker, LlamaCpp), Health (NodeHealthStatus with HealthState: Healthy/Degraded/Unavailable), Capabilities (NodeCapabilities with VramMb, SupportsStreaming), ExecuteAsync (returns InferenceResult), StreamAsync (IAsyncEnumerable<InferenceChunk> — true SSE only in NodeClient.LlamaCpp), GetHealthAsync, ListModelsAsync, DisposeAsync. InferenceNodeFactory in Infrastructure/Registry/ creates nodes from NodeConfiguration via Func<NodeConfiguration,IInferenceNode> delegate pattern registered in DI.
